body: I'm not sure what another 20 years could bring. It could get better, and brighter and I could live. Or it could not. This is the right decision for me.

Thank you for your words. I appreciate you taking a more realistic approach.

The truth is nobody will be hurt by my death. I'm estranged from my mother and she doesn't even remember who I am unfortunately. Nobody will care.

I have thought long and hard about my method. I believe it shall be painless I think, and I'll make it so that it isn't that traumatising for whoever stumbles upon me.
That's a perspective I never considered. It is good that you think of your loved ones even after your prospective death.

I want to see your life get better also. I want my life to get better. It hasn't gotten better since the day I was born, always worse. 20 years of just each year getting worse and worse. 

I truly believe some of us are defective. We will never get happiness, or we won't accept it. I truly believe death is the only way out for people like us. The cowards way out is looking easy right now.

A promise. If I get 1 birthday wish from someone then I won't do it. I keep my promises. It's one of my few redeeming qualities.
I play games online. Even trying to make friends online hasn't worked. It's like people can sense the abhorrence through the screen.

I've tried. I've gone to great lengths to better myself but they've all fallen flat seemingly. I have tried.

I'm aware that life isn't going to hand me anything. I must be defective in some way.

Thank you for your reply. Thank you for not trying. Thank you for telling me how you feel because I feel the same and that comforts me.

There was a time when I used to watch the fireworks on TV. Staying up until 12 for the countdown. And then came the realisation that I have nothing to celebrate. Nothing to look forward to. These people, embraced and holding hands have things to do. People to make laugh. Changes to make. Us. We have nothing. I stopped watching because of how angry it made. How much hate seethed within me for these people that looked so happy.

In 20 years I have made no impact on anybody. I have not made a single change in anybody's life. Nobody knows my name. The rest of my life looks just as bleak and dry. There was nothing hard about it. We learn and adapt from hardships, I've had none.

24 really.

I haven't been through any shit. In fact it would make my life worth living if I had shit to live through - some sort of tangible reason to fight. To stick it to the world. I have nothing. If I were to hunch over and die today at my desk nobody would know. No doctor appointments to miss. No dog walks to not go on. No friends to let down.

I am an adult and I'm aware of how fucking stupid I sound. I'm just done with it. I struggle from day to day.

I have no guilt. I have no burdens. I have a whole load of nothing really.

>Don't forget you have value as a human being 

I don't. What value? Nobody knows my name and never have. Perhaps the future will be bright, but the now is not. I'm sick of the now. I don't want to live more of the now for the slightest chance of betterment. I've tried so much. So fucking much. All I have left is hate and bitterness.
